{{nihongo|'''Yoshihime Shrine'''|吉姫神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Yoshihime Shrine''' (よしひめじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Konan, Shiga|Q857194|qid=Q857194}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former rank in the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Precinct ===
There is a spring in front of the shrine said to be effective for all illnesses<ref name="滋賀・びわ湖観光情報">[https://www.biwako-visitors.jp/spot/detail/8353 Yoshihime Shrine - Shiga/Biwako Tourism Information] accessed 2018-03-27</ref>. The wooden {{ill|Komainu|Q20155846|qid=Q20155846}} are also said to have been made in the {{ill|Nanboku-chō period|Q264012|qid=Q264012|lt=Nanboku-chō period}}<ref name="滋賀・びわ湖観光情報" />.

=== Festivals ===

* Annual festival: May 1
: * It forms a paired relationship with Yoshimiko Shrine, and mikoshi from both shrines come out on that day. This is called the "Ishibe Grand Festival."

=== History ===
Founding is unknown, but like {{ill|Yoshimiko Shrine|Q11413129|qid=Q11413129}}, it is regarded as a descendant shrine of Ishibe Kashioe Shrine, a Shikinaisha. Originally it stood at the current {{ill|Otabisho|Q11489117|qid=Q11489117}} location, but it burned in warfare during the {{ill|Meiō|Q1193841|qid=Q1193841}} era and is said to have moved to the current site in {{ill|1534|Q6447|qid=Q6447}} ({{ill|Tenbun|Q1192853|qid=Q1192853|lt=Tenbun}} 3). In the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}} it was called Ueda Daimyōjin-sha, but in {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 1 it received official approval to change to the current shrine name, and in September of the same year, during {{ill|Emperor Meiji|Q174231|qid=Q174231}}'s {{ill|Emperor Meiji's visits to Tokyo|Q11235215|qid=Q11235215|lt=eastward progress}}, Jingikan official {{ill|Uematsu Masakoto|Q22128646|qid=Q22128646}} was sent as envoy and offerings were granted.

=== Transportation ===
* From {{ill|Ishibe Station|Q5362466|qid=Q5362466}} on {{ill|West Japan Railway Company|Q502125|qid=Q502125|lt=JR}} {{ill|Kusatsu Line|Q865516|qid=Q865516}}, take {{ill|Konan City Community Bus|Q11563211|qid=Q11563211}}, get off at Ishibe Kōban-mae stop, then 7 minutes on foot.
* 30 minutes on foot from the same station.

=== By car ===
* About 20 minutes from {{ill|Ritto interchange|Q11110683|qid=Q11110683|lt=Rittō IC}} on the {{ill|Meishin Expressway|Q904481|qid=Q904481}}. Parking available.
